seo.title: 50 Portfolio Project Ideas for ZK Engineers
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for ZK engineers at every skill level. From simple circuits to privacy protocols, build projects that showcase your zero-knowledge expertise.

content.intro: Zero-knowledge proofs are transforming blockchain privacy and scalability. These projects help you build practical ZK skills while creating portfolio pieces that demonstrate real expertise.

sections.heading: Beginner Circuit Projects
sections.description: Start with basic circuits to understand ZK fundamentals.

items.title: Age Verification Circuit
items.description: Prove you're over 18 without revealing your actual age. Classic intro to ZK.

items.title: Password Verification
items.description: Prove you know a password without revealing it. Hash the password in-circuit.

items.title: Range Proof
items.description: Prove a number is within a range without revealing the number.

items.title: Merkle Inclusion Proof
items.description: Prove membership in a set using Merkle trees. Foundation for many ZK apps.

items.title: Simple Voting Circuit
items.description: Vote anonymously and prove you're eligible without revealing identity.

items.title: Sudoku Verifier
items.description: Prove you solved a Sudoku without revealing the solution.

items.title: Anonymous Credential System
items.description: Issue and verify credentials (degrees, certifications) without revealing holder identity.

items.title: ZK KYC Proof
items.description: Prove KYC compliance without revealing personal data to every service.

items.title: Proof of Citizenship
items.description: Prove citizenship in a country without revealing which country.

items.title: Anonymous Reputation System
items.description: Prove reputation score is above threshold without revealing exact score or identity.

items.title: ZK-Email Verifier
items.description: Prove you received an email from a domain without revealing email contents.

items.title: Soulbound Token Privacy
items.description: Add privacy to soulbound tokens. Prove you hold one without revealing which.

items.title: Private Token Mixer
items.description: Build a Tornado Cash-style mixer. Deposit and withdraw tokens anonymously.

items.title: Private Balance Proof
items.description: Prove you have sufficient balance for a transaction without revealing total balance.

items.title: Confidential Transfers
items.description: Send tokens where only sender and receiver know the amount.

items.title: Private Credit Score Proof
items.description: Prove creditworthiness without revealing financial history.

items.title: Anonymous DEX
items.description: Trade tokens without linking trades to your identity.

items.title: Private Lending Protocol
items.description: Borrow and lend with privacy. Prove collateral without revealing portfolio.

items.title: Private DAO Voting
items.description: Vote on DAO proposals without revealing your vote or token holdings.

items.title: Quadratic Voting with Privacy
items.description: Implement quadratic voting where vote weights are private.

items.title: Conviction Voting Privacy
items.description: Add privacy to conviction voting. Hide stake amounts and timing.

items.title: Anonymous Survey Tool
items.description: Conduct surveys where responses are verifiable but anonymous.

items.title: Private Election System
items.description: Full election system with registration, voting, and verifiable tallying.

items.title: ZK Battleship
items.description: Classic battleship game where board positions are committed but hidden.

items.title: Private Poker
items.description: Poker where hands are truly private until showdown.

items.title: Hidden Information Game Framework
items.description: Generic framework for any game with hidden information (fog of war).

items.title: Fair Random Number Generator
items.description: Provably fair randomness for on-chain games using ZK.

items.title: ZK Wordle
items.description: Wordle where the word is committed but hidden until game ends.

items.title: Simple ZK Rollup
items.description: Build a basic rollup that batches transactions with validity proofs.

items.title: ZK Bridge
items.description: Trustless cross-chain bridge using ZK proofs of state.

items.title: State Proof Generator
items.description: Generate proofs of Ethereum state for use in other contexts.

items.title: Transaction Batching System
items.description: Batch many transactions into one proof for gas savings.

items.title: ZK Compression
items.description: Compress on-chain data using ZK proofs (like Solana compressed NFTs).

items.title: Recursive SNARK Verifier
items.description: Verify SNARKs inside SNARKs. Foundation for proof aggregation.

items.title: Plonk Implementation
items.description: Implement Plonk proving system from scratch for deep understanding.

items.title: zkVM Prototype
items.description: Build a simple virtual machine that generates proofs of execution.

items.title: Lookup Arguments Implementation
items.description: Implement Plookup or similar for efficient lookup tables.

items.title: Custom Constraint System
items.description: Design a domain-specific constraint system optimized for your use case.

sections.heading: Developer Tools
sections.description: Tools to help other ZK developers.

items.title: Circuit Testing Framework
items.description: Automated testing tool for Circom circuits with coverage reporting.

items.title: Circuit Visualizer
items.description: Visual representation of circuit constraints for debugging.

items.title: Gas Estimator for ZK Verifiers
items.description: Estimate on-chain verification costs for different proof systems.

items.title: Proof Generation Optimizer
items.description: Tool to analyze and optimize circuit constraint count.

items.title: ZK Library Comparator
items.description: Benchmark different ZK libraries for performance and features.

gettingStarted.title: Understand the math

gettingStarted.title: Build incrementally
gettingStarted.description: Start with beginner circuits. Each concept builds on the previous.

gettingStarted.title: Study existing implementations
gettingStarted.description: Read Tornado Cash, Semaphore, and other production circuit code.

gettingStarted.title: Contribute to ZK projects
gettingStarted.description: Join ZK communities. Contribute to open source ZK tooling.
